Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated distribution with ownership, inferring that because Apple Records’ releases were historically distributed by EMI (now under Universal Music Group), the label was “part of” UMG. This misinterpreted the question and ignored authoritative evidence that Apple Records is a division of Apple Corps Ltd., leading toward an incorrect parent-company conclusion.
